'''Raw poultry''' is a raw [[food]] item dropped by chickens and parrots. It is the vanilla {{MCW|Raw Chicken|raw chicken}}, renamed by [[Matcha Flavoured]] in 1.12.3. It keeps its vanilla food values and doesn't heal. As in vanilla, it has a 30% chance to give {{EffectLink|Hunger}}, which has no lasting effect in the pack.

== Usage ==
=== Cooking ===
Raw poultry cooks into [[Cooked Chicken|cooked chicken]] in an [[oven]] or on [[kindling]], and into [[Charred Meat|charred meat]] in a [[Mud Kiln|mud kiln]].
